desc: Derive and verify the blocking condition: building i invisible from (0,h) iff max_{j<i} [(H_j − h)/X_j] ≥ (H_i − h)/X_i (grazing = blocked); invisible set is interval h ≤ t_i; answer = max_i t_i where t_i = y-intercept of line through (X_i,H_i) and some earlier top (X_j,H_j); if max t_i < 0 → -1, else answer = max t_i (0 allowed, sample 3).

Establish geometry: t_i = max over j<i of (H_j·X_i − H_i·X_j)/(X_i − X_j); maximizing j lies on the upper convex hull of previous points; intercept is unimodal along hull → binary search with exact integer comparisons.
Implement hull maintenance: append points in increasing X, maintain upper hull (pop while cross(v[-2], v[-1], p) >= 0).
Implement per-i binary search on hull for max intercept via exact integer cross-multiplication.
Track answer as exact rational (num, den); final: if num < 0 → print -1; else print float with 15 decimals.
Verify against samples 1–4 mentally (1.5; -1; 0.0; 120/7) and edge cases N=1, threshold 0.

Differential-test hull solution vs O(N²) brute force on random small inputs (ties, collinear, monotone H, N=1) — all matched exactly; hull orientation, unimodality binary search, and rational comparisons confirmed correct.
Confirm final program reads stdin/writes stdout, runs in O(N log N), and prints -1 exactly (no decimals) when appropriate.
